scope: Independent source and test review of fire-zone applicability repair; no live weather fetch or model call.

reproduction.result: National fire-zone alerts were classified unknown and suppressed a valid local posture suggestion. No independently executed reproduction is claimed.

reviewFindings: Exact full NWS zone URL equality keeps forecast and fire membership distinct even when IDs overlap.
A nonmatching zone is outside only when facility membership for that zone kind is resolved; unsupported or unresolved kinds remain unknown.
Polygon precedence and existing time/lifecycle normalization are unchanged.
New table tests cover local fire match, unrelated fire zone, missing fire lookup, forecast/fire ID overlap, unsupported and mixed unresolved kinds.
New mocked integration fixture exercises national unrelated fire evidence alongside a local warning; it expects the illustrative delay suggestion to remain available.
testExecution: Independent QA ran the three fire-zone tests successfully. Full Go race/vet is handled separately by the coordinating agent.
status: Reviewed and narrow fixture tests passed; no remaining defect identified in this scope.
boundaries: No current-weather assertion, confidence score, operational approval, simulated-send mutation, commit, push or deployment.

resolvedFinding.detail: Before repair, fire membership depended on forecast and county metadata, and geography required two memberships. Valid partial fire evidence was discarded.
resolvedFinding.suggestedRepair: Collect each nonempty validated membership independently and evaluate unknown based on the relevant kind, with single-kind and partial-points regressions.
resolvedFinding.repairReviewed: Each successful points membership is ingested independently only when its URL kind matches its field; geography needs some membership, then resolves the relevant kind.

independentTests.method: Narrow local Go tests with mocked HTTP transport; no live NOAA request.
